# SendStreak - Student Cold Outreach & Networking Habit Suite

SendStreak is a full-stack web application designed for students, researchers, alumni networkers, and early-career job seekers to build and maintain a consistent daily habit of cold emailing for internships, roles, research opportunities, and professional connections.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18+ (Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion animations, Lucide icons)
- **Backend**: Express + Node.js (TypeScript compiled to standalone CommonJS via esbuild)
- **Database & Auth**: Firebase Firestore & Firebase Auth
- **AI Engine**: Google Gemini API via server-side `@google/genai` TypeScript SDK
- **Payment Processor**: Polar.sh integration for Pro subscription upgrades
- **Mail Connection**: Google OAuth / Gmail API integration (`gmail.send`, `gmail.readonly`)

## Core Features
- **Daily Streak Engine**: Gamified tracker with daily outreach goals, streaks, prestiges, and Pro-tier streak recovery tokens.
- **AI-Powered Pitch Compiler**: Generates hyper-personalized student intro or follow-up email drafts based on candidate profiles, target lead backgrounds, resume text extraction (PDF), and customized tone/topics.
- **Lead & Contact CRM**: Student-friendly contact organizer featuring contact status, company/institution, roles, follow-up cycles, and live feedback logs.
- **Secure Gmail Connection**: Google OAuth setup for sending personalized outreach directly from standard user inboxes and checking real-time response states.

## Key Codebase Architecture
- `/server.ts`: The primary Express server and API gateway. Serves built static assets in production, configures Vite middleware in development, proxies Gemini API calls, facilitates Firebase Admin REST fallbacks, and serves fast-access health routes (`/api/health`).
- `/src/App.tsx`: Central client controller orchestrating view routes, authenticated dashboard states, and public/legal navigation wrappers.
- `/src/firebase.ts`: Orchestrates Firebase Client SDK initialization, authentication observers, and state hooks.
- `/src/components/LandingPage.tsx`: Premium landing layout optimized for student-centric search engine indexing and conversions.
- `/src/components/Dashboard.tsx`: Central hub for managing streaks, achievements, contacts queue, and active outreach pipelines.
- `/src/components/DraftGenerator.tsx`: Custom AI-draft compilation console featuring custom prompts and options.
- `/src/components/Contacts.tsx`: Leads database interface supporting bulk csv uploads, manual additions, and profile mappings.
- `/src/components/Replies.tsx`: Live response logger using secure `gmail.readonly` checks.

## Data Collections & Schemas (Firestore)
- **`users` Collection**: Stores student account status, daily quotas, subscription tier (`starter` or `pro`), current streaks, high-scores, prestige medals, profile details (major, school, achievements, resume text), and waitlist states.
- **`contacts` Sub-collection**: Keeps a record of each lead's name, role, organization, connection purpose, conversation status, generated draft content, and response status.
- **`waitlist` Collection (Supabase/Firestore)**: Private waitlist storage for email leads captured from the private beta sign-up.

## API & Server Routing Paths
- `GET /api/health` - Fast 200 OK server status check.
- `GET /api/user-profile` - Retrieves student parameters.
- `POST /api/user-profile` - Mutates user metrics or profiles.
- `POST /api/generate-draft` - Coordinates with the Google Gemini API to compile custom-tailored outreach pitches.
- `POST /api/send-email` - Leverages linked Gmail configurations to transmit drafts.
- `GET /api/check-replies` - Queries linked accounts for recent message threads.

## Development & Build Directives
- Build Script: `npm run build` (Compiles client static bundles to `dist/` and runs esbuild to pack the server into `dist/server.cjs`)
- Start Script: `npm start` (Runs standalone Node production container using `node dist/server.cjs`)
- Port Mapping: Ingress bindings are strictly configured to port `3000` (host `0.0.0.0`)
